src/data-gateway/**.purpose: Canonical data boundary: contracts, validation, source selection, transformation and read APIs
invariants: Every DataGateway member returns canonical types declared in schema/ (or primitives); source-specific shapes terminate inside a transformer
Never imports from src/app, src/components or src/config
Unknown or unparsable data becomes null, never 0 or a guess; structurally invalid data throws
The catalogue contract carries no origin URLs, repository paths or file checksums

src/data-source-static/**.purpose: Static versioned source: local JSON/GEOJSON snapshots exposed as source-native records to data-gateway
invariants: Never imports from src/app or src/data-gateway
Fails loudly when required files are missing or malformed

src/app/api/**.purpose: Public /api/* Route Handlers: request parsing, gateway call, response formatting
invariants: No module importing src/data-gateway declares runtime = 'edge'
No source-specific mapping logic inside a route handler

src/app/api/ai/spec/**.purpose: POST /api/ai/spec: calls the Naturali agent, validates its spec and, before a spec is served as a map (a 200 body), replaces mapData with real gateway data (or the cozinhas-per-município builder output) and resolves API-backed sources
invariants: NATURALI_* credentials are read only server-side and never serialized to the browser

A spec is served as a map only in a 200 body, after its mapData holds real gateway data (or the cozinhas builder output) and its API-backed sources are resolved. A 422 body is never served as a map; it carries spec only for inspection, in one of four forms: (1) the agent's reply as received, possibly normalized or locally repaired, or no spec, or a non-record value; (2) the base and agent spec merged, before any mapData replacement; (3) the spec after mapData replacement, with sources still unresolved; (4) the served spec after applyProportionalCirclesDefaults and validateWithLocalRepairs, with mapData and sources resolved
